scope_map.approval_scope: scope framework only; it does not accept sources, topics, or country completion

policy: Coverage is issue-led and separate from source acceptance. Each evidence item identifies local artifacts and labels whether it is retained law, an official-reference note, a guidance/procedure locator, or a project-authored summary. Reference notes and URLs do not count as legal text. A pathway remains incomplete until the applicable route, current legal text, implementing measures, operational process, and remedy layers are checked. The one no-54 text copy is proposal-only in open PR #167 and is not present on main.

topics.label: Access blocked before formal lodging

evidence.representation: official-reference notes only; no Immigration Act or EEA Agreement text is retained in the Norway pack

layers.open_gap: No provision-level map identifies the right to submit, the responsible authority, formal lodging, refusal to accept an application, or the Norway-specific EEA/Schengen route and exceptions. The cited legal records are locators, not retained text.

evidence.representation: official regulation and UDI guideline reference notes; no current bodies copied

layers.open_gap: The current regulation text, EEA adaptations, formal filing rules, appointment prerequisites, and any alternative or accommodation route have not been compared provision by provision.

evidence.representation: official UDI/Norway.no workflow and checklist reference notes; live operational surfaces are not captured here

layers.open_gap: Mission-specific channel, territorial responsibility, appointment access, receipt of a formal application, and current provider practice need dated route-specific verification.

evidence.representation: official appeal, tribunal, ombudsman, court and legal-aid reference notes

layers.open_gap: No decision-specific chain links refusal to lodge, written reasons, appeal body, filing deadline, judicial review, urgent relief, and legal aid.

topics.open_gap: Separate an inquiry, appointment or service-provider barrier from refusal to accept a formal filing; identify the deciding state, mission, route and applicable EEA or Schengen instrument.

topics.label: Digital-only or service-provider access requirement

layers.open_gap: No retained provision or mapped official record establishes when a Norwegian visa or residence process may require online access or must offer an alternative channel.
Delegation, accessibility, exceptions, assisted filing and any mission/provider implementing rules have not been inventoried.

evidence.representation: official checklist, self-service and routing reference notes; no versioned workflow capture

layers.open_gap: The references do not establish mandatory digital steps, accessibility accommodations, an in-person alternative, delegation terms, or a remedy when the digital channel fails.
No verified route connects digital exclusion to a formal complaint, reviewable decision, supervisory body, or urgent alternative filing.

topics.open_gap: The digital channel and its legal basis, accessibility exceptions, assisted route, and review path remain unverified.

evidence.representation: official appeal, tribunal, court and legal-aid reference notes

evidence.representation: official UDI/UNE/ombudsman practice, tribunal and complaint-route reference notes
